Md. Ahsanuddin and Others
Vs.
Md. Tota Mia and Others
full_judgment: 6. Mr. Abul Kashem, learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that on consideration of evidence on record, the trial Court came to a finding that the plaintiffs were able to prove their settlement in the suit land as well as their possession until they were dispossessed from .08 acre of land by defendant No. 1. He further submits that without reversing the findings arrived at by the trial Courts, the appellate Court erroneously came to a finding that the plaintiffs could not prove their settlement in the suit land from the Ambaria Zamindari Estate. He lastly submits that the judgment of the learned Subordinate Judge is not a proper judgment of reversal.
